search_serply: search serply api for query and return a list of SearchResult objects with link, title, and snippet
search_serply_filter_results: search serply api with a filter list to exclude unwanted domains from search results
search_serply_proxy_location: search serply api with a specific proxy location and device type for region-targeted results
search_serply_custom_count: search serply api and limit returned results to a specific count from the full result set
search_serply_language_locale: search serply api with a custom host language code for localized search results
